turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My in-laws are coming Sunday and I want to make something impressive but not stressful.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A slow roast is hard to mess up. Would you rather do a roast chicken, a lamb shoulder, or a vegetarian lasagna?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Alex real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How was the trail you did last week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Beautiful, but really muddy near the waterfall.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Would it be okay for the kids?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The first part, yes. The last mile is steep with loose rocks, I wouldn't bring them up there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could just go to the waterfall and turn back.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's the best bit anyway. They'll love it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Any thoughts on what to cook for your in-laws?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think the lamb. My father-in-law loves lamb.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then lamb it is. Rub it with garlic and rosemary and give it about four hours low and slow.
